column1: # Hand-curated layer titles, highest priority — checked before
# layer-titles.tsv (fetched from the live server) and before
# publish-layers.sh's own "_" -> " " fallback.
# Recovered from the old app's Multi_DataTree.json (removed by the
# solidjs-rewrite — see GEOSERVER_CHANGES.md), which named a layer once per
# place it appeared in the old hardcoded menu tree. That file's names aren't
# reproduced verbatim here — only the entries that are a genuine editorial
# choice (not just "_" replaced with " ", which the fallback already
# handles) and aren't superseded by a real title on the live server.
LULC_Pondy
Geomorphology_Clipped
Mangroves_2022
CIRA_PY_final
River
VillageBoundary
# Not from Multi_DataTree.json — these two are plain camelCase with no "_"
# for the fallback to split on, so they'd otherwise show unspaced.
VillageNames
SandSpit
# Also not from Multi_DataTree.json — nav.json's "Status Indicators" entry
# for this layer is editorially "Marine Pollution", not the outfall's own
# name, now that it's discovered via the StatusIndicators group.
Marine_Outfall
# Not from Multi_DataTree.json either — a new point layer recreating the old
# app's static buoy marker as a real GeoServer feature (see
# GEOSERVER_CHANGES.md's "water-quality buoy" section and chartdata.py).
WaterQuality_Buoy
